model.shadow.review.challenge-replay-ref: The stacked v0.2 ledger refuses same-root replay while its caller-owned namespace remains present and valid.

model.shadow.review.challenge-ledger-rea: The observer reads only the fixed manifest and challenge-entry paths and emits no machine state-root path.
model.shadow.review.challenge-ledger-str: Manifest, namespace inventory, entry filenames, entry receipts, ledger identity, and strict truth boundaries are validated; invalid state is never treated as unused.

model.shadow.review.challenge-ledger-sna: Snapshot content and digest rebuild exactly; observer origin and caller time remain unauthenticated.

model.shadow.review.challenge-caller-che: A privacy-bounded self-digested checkpoint retains ledger identity plus sorted challenge and consumption-receipt digests for later comparison.
model.shadow.review.challenge-checkpoint: Checkpoint summaries, canonical ordering, strict truth fields, and digest are validated without authenticating authority.

model.shadow.review.challenge-fresh-proc: Fresh Node processes compare the caller-retained checkpoint with exact, extended, missing, replaced, invalid, deleted, and identity-drift states in synthetic temporary roots.

model.shadow.review.challenge-rollback-d: Missing entries and whole-namespace absence are detected only relative to the exact checkpoint the caller presents.

model.shadow.review.challenge-replacemen: A valid replacement receipt for the same challenge digest is detected by its changed consumption-receipt digest.

model.shadow.review.challenge-ledger-ide: A different valid ledger manifest identity or invalid current state produces an explicit hold with no recovery action.

model.shadow.review.challenge-continuity: Continuity observations grant no host, human, provider, execution, evaluation, adoption, promotion, merge, Foundation, or CANON authority.
The continuity audit rebuilds from the exact prior checkpoint, current snapshot, audit id, and caller time.

model.shadow.review.challenge-checkpoint: The selftest stores a synthetic checkpoint outside the ledger namespace, but no independently operated store or retention authority is proven.
A self-digest is not an authenticated signature or host trust anchor.

model.shadow.review.challenge-deletion-r: The leaf detects presented contradictions but does not prevent deletion, rollback, checkpoint withholding, or joint ledger/checkpoint alteration.

model.shadow.review.challenge-global-sin: Comparison is bound to one presented ledger identity and does not establish global challenge uniqueness.

model.shadow.review.host-trust-anchor.ac: No Mike- or host-provisioned reviewer trust root or independently authenticated identity boundary was supplied.

model.shadow.challenger.human-review.act: Only synthetic approvals and generated keys were used; no real person reviewed a current plan.

model.shadow.challenger.shadow-execution: No model provider or shadow experiment was invoked.
model.shadow.challenger.evaluation.actua: No current baseline/challenger evaluation was executed or supplied.
model.shadow.challenger.human-benefit.he: No voluntary held-out human outcome was observed.
